sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2014
ACT XII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
No.PAB/Legis:
V (13)/2014, dated 14-2-2014.---The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances, and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2014, (Bill No.13 of
2014), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 1st
February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 14th February,
2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 in the manner hereinafter appearing:--
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's, Deputy Speaker's (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2014.

2. Amendment
of Section 5 of Act V of 1975.---In
the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act 1975 hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in Section 5 for
the words "thirty two thousand rupees" and "twenty seven
thousand rupees" the words "one hundred thousand rupees and
"ninety thousand rupees respectively" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 6-A of Act V 1975

ACT XII OF 2014
ACT XII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
4. Amendment
of Section 6-A of Act V 1975.---In
the said Act for Section 6-A, the following shall be substituted:--
"6-A,
The Speaker and a Deputy Speaker shall be entitled to telephone facilities at
office with no limit and at the residence up
to ceiling of "rupees fifteen thousand"
to the Speaker and "rupees ten thousand to the Deputy Speaker per men sum.
The Speaker and Deputy Speaker shall also be entitled to official mobile phone
connection (SIM) both for official and private purpose throughout the term of
their office and for a period of fifteen days thereafter. They will also be
entitled to free telephone facility while on tour where such facility is
available."

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 9 of Act V 1975

ACT XII OF 2014
ACT XII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
6. Amendment
of Section 9 of Act V 1975.---In
the said Act, in Section 9:--
(a) for
subsection (1) the following shall be substituted:-
"(1)
Subject to the provisions made hereinafter the Speaker and Deputy Speaker
travelling on official duty shall be entitled to get "rupees fifteen
thousand" and rupees seven thousand" respectively as daily
allowance."
(b) After
subsection (1) as so amended, the following clause (a) shall be inserted:-
"(a)
The Speaker and Deputy Speaker shall be entitled to draw six hundred thousand
rupees and five hundred thousand rupees respectively per annum as Free
Travelling Allowance (F.T.A) in Travelling vouchers or Cash."
